— He requests indexing for the new implants page. Status: requested, not guaranteed.

tree: What does a technical check look at?
Status codes, redirects, canonical tags, robots rules, titles and descriptions for each page.

tree.style: border: 1px solid rgba(16,32,26,.1); border-radius: 14px; padding: 20px 22px; background: #fff;

tree: Can you make Google index my page?
No one can guarantee that. You can request indexing, and the page shows the request as pending, not as indexed.

tree.style: border: 1px solid rgba(16,32,26,.1); border-radius: 14px; padding: 20px 22px; background: #fff;

tree: When one URL redirects to another that redirects again. Each hop is shown so it can be shortened to a single redirect.

tree.style: border: 1px solid rgba(16,32,26,.1); border-radius: 14px; padding: 20px 22px; background: #fff;

tree: Who should use technical SEO checks?
Developers, agencies and site operators responsible for keeping a site healthy across releases.

tree.style: border: 1px solid rgba(16,32,26,.1); border-radius: 14px; padding: 20px 22px; background: #fff;

tree: Can I ignore pages that are noindex on purpose?
Yes. Mark them as expected, and they stop appearing as problems.
